title: TASTE OF SOLACE! | COPICafe Episode 43 | Cornucopias
description:
In this week's episode Josh and Rob discuss the New Tokens Farm Staking program, as well as let us know that there is a new Cardano Staking program coming soon.

They discuss the optics of such topics as "Play-to-Earn" and "Play-and-Earn" and the rationale for changing the language around the words for "Rewards".

They let us know about some exciting previews that took place in Tuesdays Team Meeting, and how that will find its way out to us soon.

Of course they hit a few Community Questions, so please get your well thought out Qs into #copi-cafe-q-and-a

Then onto the LEAKS!!!

Fair disclaimer: COPILeak's are brief glimpses into the game's mechanics as they currently stand. Everything we leak can be assumed to be unfinished, is subject to change, or may never be seen again. So enjoy it while you can, and be sure to share this COPILeak with everyone you know!

00:00 Beverage Choices
01:51 Tokens Farm
02:59 Optics
08:37 Team Meeting Update
17:46 Community Questions
22:45 Leaks!

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
